The 15th annual Hiring Red, White & You statewide hiring fair comes to Laredo on Thursday, November 19, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM at the Falcon Bank Event Center, 7718 McPherson Road, Building D.

The fair connects transitioning service members, military spouses, National Guard and Reserve members, veterans and their families with employers. Veterans get priority entrance from 9:00 to 10:00 AM, and the fair opens to the general public from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

It is hosted by the Texas Workforce Commission, Workforce Solutions for South Texas, the Texas Medical Center and the Texas Veterans Commission. Dozens of employers are set to participate, including the City of Laredo, the Laredo Police Department, LISD, United ISD, TAMIU, Laredo College, Doctors Hospital of Laredo, Webb County, U.S. Border Patrol and Customs and Border Protection, TXDOT and the Texas Department of Public Safety.

There is no cost to employers to participate. Job seekers who need help finding a job can text the word JOBS to (888) 984-4826, and employers can call Workforce Solutions for South Texas at 956-794-6500.

Source: Workforce Solutions for South Texas, November 5, 2026.

title: Hiring Red, White & You veterans job fair returns to Laredo on November 19
